headline: Dead Lands Toll Soars as Stlican Shelf Fighting Resumes
war_summary: Three hours have shifted the temper of the fronts. Stlican Shelf, still at our last writing, has rejoined the battle: three base actions inside the final two hours, with Vulpine Watch and The Old Mourn the day's most fought-over posts, twenty-nine actions logged in twenty-four hours, and the Colonials holding five works to the Wardens' four. The Dead Lands now bleeds most freely of all — 992 Colonial and 1,371 Warden casualties in two hours, two further base actions, Callahan's Boot the busiest ground, and one work left to no-man's-land. Weathered Expanse has fallen quiet, its last action four hours old, though losses of 797 Colonial and 1,015 Warden in the same span, cooling but heavy, recall the day's thirty-six base actions about Necropolis and Spirit Watch. Godcrofts has recorded no fresh base fighting since evening, yet its casualty returns accelerate sharply, some 223 to each army in two hours, the Wardens keeping seven of nine works. On our count the Colonials hold 259 strategic works against 176 for the Wardens, one base demolished. It is the war's one-hundred-fifty-second day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
